metadata.title: A Curated and Snapped Geospatial Database of Heavy Metal Concentrations in River Sediments and Waters Across Bangladesh (2010–2025)
metadata.description:
Harmonized, provenance-documented, and hydrologically snapped geospatial database of heavy metal concentrations in river waters and bed sediments across Bangladesh, compiled from 28 peer-reviewed publications (2010–2025).

The database contains 557 verified analytical assays — 289 bed sediment records across 133 observation events and 268 surface water records across 12 major river basins — covering seven key trace elements (As, Cd, Cr, Cu, Ni, Pb, Zn) alongside 106 bulk physicochemical records. The dataset disambiguates 222 physical sampling stations with a canonical Station_UID primary key (85 georeferenced stations across 58 unique coordinate locations, and 137 descriptive gazetteer stations). All 85 georeferenced stations are snapped in metric UTM Zone 45N projection to topological river reach polylines from HydroSHEDS HydroRIVERS v1.0 (mean offset: 379.6 m, median: 262.1 m; 75.3% ≤ 500 m, 96.5% ≤ 1000 m).

Formats: SQLite relational database (8 tables, 2 views), Apache Parquet columnar files, flat CSV tables, GeoPackage (clipped HydroRIVERS network), GeoJSON (national boundary).

Companion Code: https://github.com/ShMazumder/heavy-metal
metadata.notes: Companion dataset for a multi-publication research initiative on heavy metal contamination in Bangladesh river systems: (1) Systematic review and evidence map; (2) Surface water regulatory screening and surveillance analysis; (3) Bed sediment spatial machine learning; (4) Geospatial data descriptor.
